A.name: screenshot-4m-to-5m
A.physicalRelation: 4M has two yard ends; 4S blocks the south path and 4N blocks the north path. Moving either blocking vehicle to a validated temporary slot opens one egress end; that temporary move requires recovery after 75-01 reaches 5M.

B.name: screenshot-74-10-5m-to-6s
B.physicalRelation: 74-11 and 74-12 occupy both open paths from 5M. A stale cancelled release identity must be rejected and replaced by a complete release/main/recovery chain to the exact requested target 6S.

C.name: source-6s
C.physicalRelation: 6SS blocks the south path and 6N blocks the north path from 6S; a temporary release and recovery are required.

D.name: source-7s
D.physicalRelation: 7SS and 7N occupy both physical egress paths from 7S; a complete temporary release/main/recovery chain is possible.

E.name: source-8s
E.physicalRelation: 8SS and 8N occupy both egress paths from 8S; a complete temporary release/main/recovery chain is possible.

F.name: recursive-two-blocker
F.physicalRelation: 4S has only the north egress path. F-INNER in 4M and F-OUTER in 4N both block it; F-INNER is itself blocked north by F-OUTER and south by the main vehicle, so F-OUTER must move before F-INNER.

G.name: no-complete-solution
G.physicalRelation: Both 4M egress paths are blocked and every ordinary temporary holding candidate plus VN is occupied; no complete release/recovery plan exists.

H.name: retarget-before-first
H.physicalRelation: The unresolved recursive chain is recomputed atomically when a prerequisite, main or recovery target changes.

I.name: mid-chain-retarget
I.physicalRelation: After the first prerequisite is physically completed, its destination is actual state and only the unresolved suffix is replanned.

J.name: independent-plan
J.physicalRelation: The second plan is on a non-conflicting track/resource and remains identity-stable during trapped-chain retarget.

K.name: nested-vn-rejection
K.physicalRelation: VN rejection is contextual to the unresolved release step; a complete safe local alternative is selected when available.

L.name: direct-untrapped
L.physicalRelation: At least one 4M egress end and one 5M ingress end are clear, so the direct move needs no release or recovery.
